meta.description: All Special Abilities (SA) for TDE4/DSA4.1. Grouped by category: melee_combat, ranged_combat, magic, general. AP cost is the Adventure Points cost after character creation. gp_cost_creation is the equivalent GP cost at creation (AP/50 rounded up, unless specifically listed). Where auto_for or discounted_for are listed, those races/cultures/professions grant or discount the SA.

special_abilities.name: Ambidextrous Combat I

effects.description: Reduces off-hand AT/PA penalties to -3/-3

special_abilities.description: Reduces the penalties in combat with the left hand to -3/-3 and allows additional maneuvers. Required for Double Attack and Death from the Left.

special_abilities.name: Ambidextrous Combat II

effects.description: Removes all off-hand penalties
Provides an additional Attack or Parry with the secondary weapon once per round

special_abilities.description: Removes the penalties for fighting with the left hand entirely and provides one additional Attack or Parry with the secondary weapon per round.

special_abilities.name: Armor Use I

effects.description: Reduce EC by 1 for one particular type of armor

special_abilities.description: Reduces Encumbrance (EC) by 1 point for one particular type of armor chosen at acquisition. Warriors receive this automatically for long chainmail.

special_abilities.name: Armor Use II

effects.description: Reduce EC by 1 for all types of armor

special_abilities.description: Reduces Encumbrance (EC) by 1 point for all types of armor.

special_abilities.name: Armor Use III

effects.description: Reduce EC by 2 for all types of armor

special_abilities.description: Reduces Encumbrance (EC) by 2 points for all types of armor.

special_abilities.name: Blade Storm

effects.description: Enables the Blade Storm attack action against two (or three with Blade Dancer) opponents

special_abilities.description: Enables the use of the Blade Storm combat action, attacking two opponents as a single attack action.

special_abilities.name: Called Attack

effects.description: Called Attack adds the full Call to Damage Points instead of half

special_abilities.description: Improves the Called Attack maneuver: the full Call (not just half) is added to Damage Points on a successful hit.

special_abilities.name: Charge

effects.description: Enables the Charge combat action

special_abilities.description: Enables the use of the Charge combat action.

special_abilities.name: Cleave Attack

effects.description: Enables the Cleave Attack combat action against up to three opponents

special_abilities.description: Enables the use of the Cleave Attack combat action, attacking up to three opponents and knocking them back.

special_abilities.name: Combat Awareness

effects.description: Increases Base Initiative by 2
Parrying or dodging free attacks is 2 points easier
Orientation requires only 1 action and no IN test
With Blade Storm SA, can freely distribute improved AV between two opponents (min 6 per attack)

special_abilities.description: Increases Base Initiative by 2 and makes parrying or dodging free attacks 2 points easier. Allows orientation with only 1 action and no Intuition test.

special_abilities.name: Combat Reflexes

effects.description: Increases the Initiative Value by 4 points

special_abilities.description: Increases the Initiative Value by 4 points.

special_abilities.name: Death Blow

effects.description: Enables the Death Blow combat action

special_abilities.description: Enables the use of the Death Blow combat action, a highly risky maneuver that ignores armor and inflicts two additional wounds.

special_abilities.name: Death from the Left

effects.description: Enables the Death from the Left combat action

special_abilities.description: Enables the use of the Death from the Left combat action.

special_abilities.name: Double Attack

effects.description: Enables the Double Attack combat action

special_abilities.description: Enables the use of the Double Attack combat action.

special_abilities.name: Feint

effects.description: Feint penalizes the defender's Parry by the full Call instead of half

special_abilities.description: Improves the Feint maneuver: the defender must accept the full Call as a Parry penalty (not just half). Required for several advanced maneuvers.

special_abilities.name: Hammer Strike

effects.description: Enables the Hammer Strike combat action (triple damage on success)

special_abilities.description: Enables the use of the Hammer Strike combat action, giving up all actions for the round to inflict triple damage.

special_abilities.name: Knockdown

effects.description: Enables the Knockdown combat action

special_abilities.description: Enables the use of the Knockdown combat action.

special_abilities.name: Off-hand Fighting

effects.description: Adds 1 additional point to the Parry Value when using a shield

special_abilities.description: Adds 1 additional point to the Parry Value when using a shield. Required for all Ambidextrous Combat and Parrying Weapons SAs.

special_abilities.name: Parrying Weapons I

effects.description: The PV of the primary weapon is modified by -1 plus the PV of the parrying weapon

special_abilities.description: When using a parrying weapon in the off-hand, the primary weapon's Parry Value is modified by -1 + the parrying weapon's PV.

special_abilities.name: Parrying Weapons II

effects.description: The PV of the primary weapon is modified by +2 plus the PV of the parrying weapon
Grants a Supplemental Attack or Parry

special_abilities.description: When using a parrying weapon, the primary weapon's PV is modified by +2 + parrying weapon's PV.

special_abilities.name: Shield Fighting I

effects.description: Adds 2 points to the Parry Value when using a shield

special_abilities.description: Adds 2 points to the Parry Value when using a shield.

special_abilities.name: Shield Fighting II

effects.description: Adds 2 additional points to the Parry Value when using a shield (total +4 with Shield Fighting I)

special_abilities.description: Adds 2 additional points to the Parry Value when using a shield (stacks with Shield Fighting I for total +4).

special_abilities.name: Shield Splitter

effects.description: Enables the Shield Splitter combat action

special_abilities.description: Enables the use of the Shield Splitter combat action, attacking an opponent's shield to destroy it.

special_abilities.name: Stun Blow

effects.description: Enables the Stun Blow combat action
Halves the AT penalties for Blunt Blow

special_abilities.description: Enables the Stun Blow combat action and halves the AT penalties for Blunt Blow.

special_abilities.name: Targeted Thrust

effects.description: Enables the Targeted Thrust combat action

special_abilities.description: Enables the use of the Targeted Thrust combat action, attacking a vulnerable spot and ignoring armor.

special_abilities.name: Lunge

effects.description: Enables the Lunge combat action, stepping forward into a thrust

special_abilities.description: Enables the Lunge (Ausfall) maneuver. Can be combined with Double Attack.

special_abilities.name: Half-Sword

effects.description: Allows Death Blow and Targeted Thrust with Swords talent

special_abilities.description: Allows the use of Death Blow and Targeted Thrust with swords (normally restricted to daggers, fencing weapons, and spears).

special_abilities.name: Steady Stand

effects.description: Knockdown ST test is 1 point easier

special_abilities.description: Makes Knockdown ST tests 1 point easier. Received automatically by Mountebanks.

special_abilities.name: Blade Dancer

effects.description: Suffers only half the declared points as a penalty on a failed Call
With Blade Storm SA, can split attack among up to three opponents

special_abilities.description: A fighter with this SA only suffers half of the declared Call points as a penalty on a failed maneuver. With Blade Storm, can attack up to three opponents.

special_abilities.name: Mounted Combat

effects.description: Allows full combat talent use while mounted

special_abilities.description: Enables full combat talent usage while mounted. Required for effective fighting from horseback.

special_abilities.name: Alertness

effects.description: Orientation requires only 1 action and no IN test (when also having Combat Awareness)

special_abilities.description: Increases alertness and situational awareness. Prerequisite for Combat Awareness. Allows single-action orientation when combined with Combat Awareness.

special_abilities.name: Dodge I

effects.description: Allows using Dodge as a defensive action
Dodge value equals AG/2

special_abilities.description: Allows using Dodge as a defensive action against melee attacks. Dodge value equals AG/2.

special_abilities.name: Dodge II

effects.description: Improved Dodge value

special_abilities.description: Improves Dodge value and effectiveness against ranged attacks.

special_abilities.name: Terrain Familiarity

effects.description: The hero is at home in a specific terrain type and receives bonuses to relevant tests

special_abilities.notes: First terrain costs 3 GP at creation. Each additional terrain costs 2 GP. Multiple Terrain Familiarity SAs = different terrain types.
special_abilities.description: The hero has extensive experience in a specific terrain type, gaining situational bonuses for navigation, survival, and related tests in that environment.

special_abilities.name: Cultural Lore

effects.description: Deep familiarity with a specific culture's customs, law, social norms, and practices

special_abilities.notes: Own culture: 0 GP at creation. Each additional culture: 3 GP. Multiple Cultural Lore SAs = different cultures.
special_abilities.description: Deep knowledge of a specific culture's customs, social norms, laws, history, and practices. Provides bonuses to Etiquette and social tests within that culture.

special_abilities.name: Local Knowledge

effects.description: Detailed knowledge of a specific town, city district, or location

special_abilities.notes: Multiple Local Knowledge SAs = different locations.
special_abilities.description: Detailed knowledge of a specific location (town, city district, road, etc.), enabling easier navigation and finding contacts.

special_abilities.name: Talent Specialization

effects.description: Effective TP is 2 points higher in the specialized sub-area; can exceed normal max TP cap by 2

special_abilities.notes: First specialization at TP 7; second at TP 14; third at TP 21; fourth at TP 28. Cannot double-specialize in same area for +4.
special_abilities.description: A specialization in a specific sub-area of a talent. Provides +2 effective TP in that sub-area. For combat talents: +1 AT and +1 PA with the specific weapon (or +2 ranged attack for ranged weapons).

special_abilities.name: Nandus-Pleasing Knowledge

effects.description: Exceptional academic breadth; bonuses to lore and knowledge tests

special_abilities.description: Represents exceptional academic knowledge and broad curiosity. Provides bonuses to lore-related talent tests and represents encyclopedic learning.

special_abilities.name: Master of Improvisation

effects.description: Can use improvised tools more effectively; reduced penalties for working without proper equipment

special_abilities.description: The hero excels at making do with whatever is at hand, reducing penalties for improvised tools and creative solutions.

special_abilities.name: Hail of Iron

effects.description: Can launch multiple throwing rings, discs, or stars simultaneously

special_abilities.description: Specialists in throwing rings, discs, or stars can utilize Hail of Iron to launch multiple projectiles simultaneously.

special_abilities.name: Master Marksman

effects.description: No penalty for a Snap Shot
An aimed shot only requires one additional action instead of two

special_abilities.description: No penalty for a Snap Shot; aimed shots only require one additional action instead of two.

special_abilities.name: Mounted Marksman

effects.description: Only half the usual penalties when shooting or throwing from a moving mount

special_abilities.description: A Mounted Marksman takes only half the usual penalties when taking a shot or throwing a weapon from a moving mount.

special_abilities.name: Quick Draw

effects.description: Drawing a throwing weapon from belt sheath is a Free Action; from back sheath is a single action

special_abilities.description: Dramatically speeds up drawing throwing weapons: belt sheath becomes a Free Action, back sheath becomes a single action.

special_abilities.name: Quick Load
special_abilities.description: For Bows, loading time is reduced by 1 action. For Crossbows, loading time is reduced to three-quarters.

special_abilities.name: Sharpshooter

effects.description: Full Called Shot value applied instead of only half

special_abilities.description: The penalty for a Snap Shot is reduced to 1 point instead of 2. When making a Called Shot, the full value is added instead of only half.

special_abilities.name: Astral Meditation

effects.description: The magic user can convert their own Vitality Points into Astral Points during meditation

special_abilities.description: The magic user can convert their own life energy (VP) into astral energy (ASP). Used during extended rest periods.

special_abilities.name: Great Meditation

effects.description: Improves meditation for ASP recovery and enables extended trance-like meditation for deeper regeneration

special_abilities.description: Enhanced meditation abilities for deeper Astral Point recovery and extended meditation.

special_abilities.name: Elven Representation

effects.description: Grants access to the Elven Heritage spell representation

special_abilities.description: Grants access to the Elven Heritage (Elfenlied) spell representation. Automatic for elves in the Lea Elves culture.

special_abilities.name: Salasandra

effects.description: Deep connection with nature spirits; bonuses to nature-related tests and communication with plant/animal life

special_abilities.description: An elven ability representing communion with nature spirits (Salasandras). Provides bonuses to nature-related activities.

special_abilities.name: Swamp Lore

effects.description: Expert knowledge of swamp environments and their dangers

special_abilities.description: Expert knowledge of swamp terrain, plants, animals, and navigation. A subtype of Terrain Familiarity.

special_abilities.name: Sea Lore

effects.description: Expert knowledge of maritime environments, navigation, and seafaring

special_abilities.description: Expert knowledge of maritime environments, sea navigation, weather at sea, and maritime survival.

special_abilities.name: Cave Lore

effects.description: Expert knowledge of underground environments and cave systems

special_abilities.description: Expert knowledge of underground environments, cave systems, and subterranean survival.

special_abilities.name: Desert Lore

effects.description: Expert knowledge of desert environments

special_abilities.description: Expert knowledge of desert environments, survival techniques, and navigation in arid regions.

special_abilities.name: Ice Lore

effects.description: Expert knowledge of frozen and arctic environments

special_abilities.description: Expert knowledge of icy, frozen, and arctic environments, survival, and navigation.

special_abilities.name: Combat in Water

effects.description: Reduces penalties for fighting in water or aboard ships in rough conditions

special_abilities.description: Reduces or eliminates penalties for fighting in water, reducing drowning risk during combat.

special_abilities.name: Regeneration I

effects.description: Recover 1 additional ASP per rest phase

special_abilities.description: Recover 1 additional Astral Point during rest. The SA equivalent of the Astral Regeneration advantage for incremental advancement.

special_abilities.name: Unarmed Combat Style: Hammerfist

effects.description: Specific Thorwalian brawling style; bonuses to Brawling attacks and specific grapple maneuvers

special_abilities.description: A traditional Thorwalian unarmed combat style focused on powerful hammer strikes with the fists.

special_abilities.name: Unarmed Combat Style: Unau School

effects.description: Novadi wrestling and striking style; bonuses to grappling and unarmed combat

special_abilities.description: A traditional Novadi unarmed combat school combining wrestling and striking techniques.

special_abilities.name: Friendship Song

effects.description: A magical song that improves social reactions from animals and nature spirits

special_abilities.description: An elven magical song that soothes animals and nature spirits, improving their reactions.
